ValidationRule.description: Promotion Name is mandatory if Case Reason Field value is Promotion (NQC)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', TEXT($User.UserType) <> 'AutomatedProcess', $Profile.Name <> 'Nexus Data Loader', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Latam_Non_Quality', ISPICKVAL(Reason, 'Promotion (NQC)'), ISBLANK(Promotions_Name__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Promotion Name is required when Case Reason is Promotion(NQC)
